focus: 1949 public-health ministry legislative debate; 1949 prosecution act; 1950 Bank of Korea

verified.fact: Health ministry petition adopted: present 129, yes 67, no 31.
Health ministry bill passed: present 137, yes 94, no 15. Contrary to a later summary, there was substantive debate.
Prosecution bill passed: present 122, yes 97, no 1; article 36 amendment retained.
